text:
tess: Quick preflight for the announcement — we need: final 2-3 changelog bullets, a docs URL we can link to, one short benchmark stat for the hero, and confirmation of canary timing. Also: is there an embargo window? @leo @nina @omar

leo: Canary can start 2026-04-03 08:30 PT. We'll roll at 5% -> 25% over 2 hours, fallback to region-primary if errors spike. No infra changes after 08:00 PT please. :hourglass:

nina: Docs PR here: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/477 — landing page anchor needs the short "what's new" blurb and the quickstart snippet. I can post the final URL after merge.

omar: Embargo OK until 2026-04-03 16:00 PT (global send). Hero benchmark: "~20% lower median token latency on short prompts (internal suite)." Hero quote: "Makes inference predictable so teams can ship features faster." Keep <120 chars.

tess: Nice. We need exactly three changelog bullets — concise, non-technical phrasing preferred. Can eng paste them here?

leo: Draft changelog bullets:
- 20% lower median token latency for short prompts via smarter kernel routing
- Adaptive prefix/KV caching reduces duplicate compute across chat sessions
- Dedicated rollout now supports regional fallback and canary scheduling

omar: Tiny wording nits: change "smarter kernel routing" -> "optimized request routing" and mention quantization guide is coming next week.

leo: Updated bullets: 
- 20% lower median token latency for short prompts via optimized request routing
- Adaptive prefix/KV caching reduces duplicate compute across chat sessions
- Dedicated rollout now supports regional fallback and canary scheduling (quantization guide coming)

nina: Perfect. I'll add the quickstart code block to the docs and include an anchor so marketing can deep-link. Snippet:
```
POST /v1/generate
Host: api.redwood.ai
{ "model": "redwood-medium", "prompt": "Summarize..." }
```

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-04-03T15:30:00Z on cluster-eu-west-1. Policy: initial=5%, step=25%/hr, fallback=automatic.

tess: Got it — marketing timeline: draft post + landing page by 2026-03-31 EOD, approvals by 2026-04-01 noon PT, publish after embargo 2026-04-03 16:00 PT. Webinar slot tentatively 2026-04-04 10:00 PT; registration page goes live with the announce link.

omar: I'll send the PM hero quote asset and a short 140-char benchmark line in the next 30m.

nina: Once PR merges I'll paste the canonical docs URL here and set up the redirect from /docs/old-dedicated.

tess: Closing loop: marketing will assemble copy from these bullets and the hero text. If anyone needs to move the canary window, flag here before 2026-03-31 17:00 PT. Thanks :rocket:
